title: Download Sea Ice Concentration Data from the NSIDC Climate Data Record
text: Use cdr_* functions download satellite-derived Antarctic Arctic sea ice concentration data monthly daily resolution. use version 5 default version 4 also supported. basic usage downloads NetCDF file temporary directory. default, files downloaded needed. four simple functions download whole-domain data: cdr() function exposes arguments download crazy subset cdr_fix() function fix grid information make work CDO standardise variable names. requires CDO installed system.
code: library(icecdr)  dates <- c("2020-01-01", "2023-01-01") cdr_antarctic_monthly(dates, dir = "data") #> Downloading data. #> [1] "data/05c77e3b938053bdbed2137c61dc6052.nc" system.time(cdr_antarctic_monthly(dates, dir = "data")) #> Returning existing file. #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.019   0.000   0.020 cdr_antarctic_daily() cdr_antarctic_monthly()  cdr_arctic_daily() cdr_arctic_monthly() cdr(date_range = dates,     # Data every 7 days     date_stride = 7,     resolution = "daily",      # Thin the grid by taking every other gridpoint     xgrid_stride = 2,     ygrid_stride = 2,      hemisphere = "north"     ) library(rcdo) library(ggplot2)  extent_cdr <- cdr_antarctic_monthly(dates, dir = "data") |>    cdr_fix() |>    cdo_gtc(0.15) |>   cdo_fldint() |>    cdo_execute() |>    metR::ReadNetCDF(c(extent = "aice"))  #> Warning: Using CDO version 2.4.0 which is different from the version supported by this #> version of rcdo (2.5.1). #> ℹ This warning is displayed once per session. #> Returning existing file.  extent_index <- sea_ice_index("south", "monthly", dir = "data") |>    data.table::fread() |>   subset(time >= dates[1] & time <= dates[2]) #> Downloading data.  extent_cdr |>   ggplot(aes(time, extent)) +   geom_line(aes(colour = "cdr")) +   geom_line(data = extent_index, aes(colour = "sea_ice_index")) +   labs(y = "Sea ice extent")

title: Download sea ice concentration from NSIDC Climate Data Record — cdr
text: date_range Vector size two start end dates. vector size one passed, value recycled size 2. Supported formats : Date POSIXct/POSIXlt object. character vector ISO format dates: c("2020-01-01", "2020-12-31") character vector year-month: c("2020-01", "2020-06") (expands first/last day month). character vector year : c("2020", "2021") (expands full year). variables Character vector variables fetch. Valid values qa Quality control flag. stdev Sea ice standard deviation. interpolation_spatial Flag spatial interpolation. interpolation_temporal Flag temporal interpolation. aice_bt Sea ice concentration Bootstrap method. aice_nt Sea ice concentration Nasa Team method. Although variables available versions resolutions. *_nt *_bt variables available version 4 interpolation flags available daily values. hemisphere Character hemisphere download. Can either "south" "north". resolution Character temporal resolution. Can either "monthly" "daily". date_stride Numeric temporal stride. number greater 1 means take nth date series. xgrid_range Numeric vector size 2 range x dimension. xgrid_stride Numeric stride x dimension. ygrid_range Numeric vector size 2 range y dimension. ygrid_stride Numeric stride y dimension. version Version dataset. Can 4 5. format Character format. file Character file name use download. NULL, file name constructed hashing request URL. Requests consisting one file append number. dir Directory download file. use_cache Logical indicating whether perform download file already exist.

title: Download sea ice index data. — sea_ice_index
text: returned files raw files, contain minor format modifications ease use. Instead year month columns, single time column. Instead region column "S" "N" values, hemisphere column values "south" "north" (consistency function arguments). Column names lower case daily monthly products, except area column available monthly product. Area extent values expressed km^2.
